description: Send ONE test event to Snap's Conversions API validate endpoint, to check your server-side tracking is built correctly. It is a test: Snap does not count it as a real conversion, and this server has no tool that sends real conversion events. Events: PAGE_VIEW, VIEW_CONTENT, ADD_CART, START_CHECKOUT, SIGN_UP, PURCHASE. A PURCHASE needs value and currency. The email, if given, is hashed here and only the hash is sent. Read the answer with snap_capi_status. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

email.description: A test email address. It is hashed before it is sent.

event_name.description: The Conversions API event to test, for example PURCHASE.

event_source_url.description: An https page of your store

order_id.description: A test order id for the test event.

pixel_id.description: Snap Pixel id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_PIXEL_ID. Get it from snap_list_pixels.

value.description: The number to apply: the new amount, or the multiplier when mode is scale.

name: snap_capi_test_event
